item: Practising advocate (advokát), member of the Slovak Bar Association
value: Part of 47,410 EUR of income outside public office declared for 2023
detail: TASR's official profile states that he is a member of the Slovak Bar Association (Slovenská advokátska komora) and has represented victims of crime; Pravda and TA3 report that his declaration for 2023 lists activity as an advocate alongside his public office. Slovak public officials file an annual declaration (oznámenie funkcionára) with the National Council's Committee on Incompatibility of Functions, which publishes it on nrsr.sk; that site was not readable for this research (bot check), so the figures are taken from press reports that cite the declaration.
